name: vsftpd-anonymous
description: Practice-box misconfiguration: installs vsftpd (if needed) and enables anonymous FTP (anonymous_enable=YES). Paired check wants anonymous disabled or the server removed. No vars.
script:
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
command -v vsftpd >/dev/null 2>&1 || { apt-get update -y >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; apt-get install -y vsftpd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; }
f=/etc/vsftpd.conf
[ -e "$f" ] || printf 'listen=YES\nlocal_enable=YES\n' > "$f"
if grep -qi '^anonymous_enable' "$f"; then
  sed -i 's/^anonymous_enable=.*/anonymous_enable=YES/I' "$f"
else
  printf 'anonymous_enable=YES\n' >> "$f"
fi
systemctl enable --now vsftpd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
systemctl restart vsftpd >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
